themes.toggle: User-controlled via a header sun/moon button; persisted to localStorage; falls back to prefers-color-scheme, then dark, before first paint via a blocking inline script.

display.purpose: The photographer's name in the hero only — massive, elegant, breathing. Weight 300.

headline.purpose: Page and section titles: Featured Projects, About, Get in Touch. Weight 400 max.

title.purpose: Project titles on hover, card headings.

body.purpose: Running copy, light-weight so it never competes with imagery.

caption.purpose: Image captions, metadata, dates — always muted-gray.

label.purpose: Navigation links, eyebrows, category tags — uppercase, tracked wide.

logo.purpose: The site wordmark only — uppercase, generously tracked.

index.purpose: Recessive numeral watermark on Gear/Services cards (01, 02, ...) — clamp(3rem,8vw,5rem), weight 300, -0.02em tracking, always the dedicated index-number color, never body text color.

mono.purpose: Reserved strictly for counting or measuring: lightbox image counters, spec/value tables. Never for labels, categories, or prose.

shadows.name: deep-float
shadows.purpose: Lightbox overlay — the deepest float in the system.

motion.name: dur-base
motion.purpose: Standard transitions: image opacity, header fade on scroll.

motion.name: hover-image-scale
motion.purpose: Project card and gallery cover hover.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: White background, void-black text, minimal 4px radius. Main CTAs ("Get in touch", "Contact" in the mobile drawer). Hover dims to soft-white.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 48px; padding: 0 32px; background: #ffffff; color: #0a0a0a; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.15em; text-transform: uppercase; border: none; border-radius: 4px; transition: background-color 220ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #f5f5f5; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 1.5px solid #ffffff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Transparent background, white text, subtle border (#333333). Hover brightens the border to full white.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 12px 24px; background: transparent; color: #ffffff; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 300; border: 1px solid #333333; border-radius: 4px; transition: border-color 220ms; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: #ffffff; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 1.5px solid #ffffff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Arrow Link
components.description: Text link followed by a → arrow, no underline at rest. Underline appears with 4px offset on hover. Used for "Learn More About Me →", "View All Projects →".
components.css: .ds-link-arrow { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; color: #ffffff; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 300; text-decoration: none; transition: opacity 200ms; } .ds-link-arrow:hover { opacity: 0.7; } .ds-link-arrow svg { transition: transform 200ms; } .ds-link-arrow:hover svg { transform: translateX(4px); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Dark elevated background (surface-elevated), subtle border (border-dark), white text. Focus shifts the border to muted-gray, never a colored ring.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: 14px 16px; background: #1a1a1a; color: #ffffff; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; border: 1px solid #2a2a2a; border-radius: 4px; transition: border-color 120ms, box-shadow 120ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #666666; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #888888; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(255,255,255,0.08); }

components.name: Project Card (Hover Overlay)
components.description: The system's signature interaction: a full-bleed image with an invisible gradient overlay that reveals the title (Title style, white) and category/count (Caption style, muted-gray) bottom-left on hover, alongside a subtle 1.02 image scale.
components.html:
People

28 photographs
components.css: .ds-project-card { position: relative; display: block; aspect-ratio: 4/5; overflow: hidden; } .ds-project-card img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; transition: transform 500ms ease-out; } .ds-project-card:hover img { transform: scale(1.02); } .ds-project-overlay { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(0,0,0,0.8) 0%, transparent 60%); opacity: 0; transition: opacity 400ms ease; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: flex-end; padding: 24px; } .ds-project-card:hover .ds-project-overlay { opacity: 1; } .ds-project-title { font-family: 'Space Grotesk', -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 400; color: #ffffff; margin: 0; } .ds-project-meta { font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: #888888; margin: 4px 0 0; }

components.name: Contact Info Block
components.description: Icon + label + value rows: a 40x40 rounded-square surface-elevated icon container (muted-gray icon), a caption-style muted-gray label, and a body-style white value. 24px vertical gap between rows.
components.css: .ds-contact-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; margin-bottom: 24px; } .ds-contact-icon { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 40px; height: 40px; flex: none; background: #1a1a1a; border-radius: 8px; color: #888888; } .ds-contact-label { display: block; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: #888888; } .ds-contact-value { display: block; margin-top: 2px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; color: #ffffff; }

components.name: Theme Toggle
components.description: Icon-only sun/moon button in the header (desktop nav) and mobile drawer. Shows a sun when the current theme is dark (click to go light), a moon when light (click to go dark). Renders an empty placeholder span until mounted to avoid a hydration mismatch, since the real theme is only knowable client-side.
components.html: <button class="ds-theme-toggle" aria-label="Switch to light mode"><svg><!-- sun or moon icon, 18px, strokeWidth 1.5 --></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-theme-toggle { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 20px; height: 20px; color: #888888; background: transparent; border: none; transition: color 220ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-theme-toggle:hover { color: #ffffff; }

narrative.overview: This portfolio exists as a digital gallery space — a near-black void where photographs float luminous and untouched, in the spirit of a museum exhibition. Dark is the default and the primary reading experience, but a user-controlled light theme is available as a full grayscale mirror of the same system (same tokens, roles, and rules — just inverted), for viewers who prefer it. The design never mixes light and dark within a single view; the whole canvas commits to one theme at a time.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black canvas (#0a0a0a) by default that makes photographs luminous by contrast, with a pure-white mirror theme available via a header toggle
Technical, geometric sans-serif (Space Grotesk, 300 for Display, 400 max elsewhere) for all display typography
Clean, light-weight sans-serif (Inter) for body text
A dedicated recessive index-number color/size token for Gear and Services card numerals — distinct from body/muted text
Full-bleed, edge-to-edge imagery with no visible frames or borders
Generous negative space — sections breathe, content never crowds
Minimal navigation chrome — transparent header fading to surface on scroll, with a sun/moon theme toggle
Hover-revealed project titles over a dark gradient, never a persistent label

rules.name: The Consistent Canvas Rule
rules.body: The page background always commits fully to the active theme (all-dark or all-light) via [data-theme] tokens. There are no alternating light/dark bands within a single view; the theme is user-controlled (toggle, persisted to localStorage) but never mixed.

rules.name: The Two-Tone Rule
rules.body: Text is either the theme's primary text color or its muted color. There is no third text color. Hierarchy comes from weight, size, and spacing — never from adding more grays.

rules.name: The Light Touch Rule
rules.body: Display type is weight 300; headline type never exceeds weight 400. Boldness comes from size and space, not from weight.

rules.name: The Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Every page title has an eyebrow label above it, always caption-style muted, uppercase, tracked at 0.15em.

rules.name: The Mono Rule
rules.body: Monospace type is reserved strictly for counting or measuring (lightbox image counters, spec/value tables). Never use it for labels, categories, or prose.

rules.name: The Grounded-by-Default Rule
rules.body: If it's on the page, it sits flat on the canvas. If it's floating above the page (overlay, drawer, lightbox), it gets a shadow. There is no ambient shadow on cards or buttons.

dos: Do let photographs bleed edge-to-edge whenever possible. The grid is invisible; the work fills the space.
Do keep typography light-weight (300 for Display, 400 max elsewhere). Elegance, not aggression.
Do use generous whitespace between sections. Each section should breathe.
Do apply hover overlays with gradient + title on all portfolio imagery.
Do commit fully to one theme (dark or light) per view — never mix.
Do use the arrow link pattern ("View All Projects →") for secondary navigation.
donts: Don't add visible borders or frames around photographs. The image edge is the frame.
Don't use bold (600+) weights for display type. Keep it light.
Don't introduce colored accents. This is a pure monochrome system — white/black and grays in either theme.
Don't add shadows to resting elements. Shadow means floating.
Don't use card backgrounds or elevated surfaces for project thumbnails. Images sit directly on the canvas.
Don't crowd sections. If it feels tight, add more space.
Don't use mono type for anything other than counting or measuring.
